Corrigendum: Plant-derived immunomodulators: an insight on their preclinical evaluation and clinical trials
No study will investigate the immunomodulatory effects of capsaicin. It can be concluded that, in comparison with neuropathic pain, the field of inflammation and capsaicin is not very cutting-edge and will stay on that level in the near future owing to lack of clinical trials.
An additional task is the classification of plant-derived immunomodulatory agents in a specific class or among classes as per inherent risk. This classification of novel plant derived immunomodulatory agents by level of risk can be endeavored from collective knowledge of meta-analyses of clinical trials, national registries and physicians.
Innovative technologies and the excessive research on immunomodulatory natural products, plants, their extracts, and their active moieties with immunomodulatory potential, may provide us with valuable entities to develop as novel immunomodulatory agents to supplement the present chemotherapies. This review focuses on the plant-based immunomodulatory compounds undergoing clinical trials.
